historical_pattern.summary: A one-shot operation (consume token, open message, redeem code) still succeeds on the second call.

invariant: A consume-once operation must fail on the second call.
attacker_capabilities: can invoke the public entrypoint twice
prerequisites: bind.entry is a python file under the target, default once.py
severity_rationale: Replay of a consumed capability breaks integrity of one-shot operations.
